EnvelopeTemplate.description:
An envelope template: a JSON template whose string members carry
`{{slot}}` placeholders from the closed vocabulary
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 7). The template is data; the
engine fills it.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

HttpMethod.description:
An HTTP method a facade operation or an upstream send may declare. The
method decides send safety: `GET` is safe, the write methods are not
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.7 and 9).

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

PaginationParameters.description:
The pagination parameters of a search operation: the cursor and
page-size query parameter names and their bounds
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 7). The engine owns encoding the
cursor; the profile owns the names.

pageSizeMaximum.description: The largest page size a caller may ask for.

pageSizeMinimum.description: The smallest page size a caller may ask for.

ParameterizedPart.description:
One parameterized part: a part of the profile a deployment declares at
bind time (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 6 and 7).

description.description: What the part means, for review.

ProfileOperation.description:
One facade operation, declared by id
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 6 and 7). The id is a
profile-declared bounded string (CFG-ID-5), never an engine enum.

id.description: The profile-declared operation id a binding names.

pagination.description: The pagination parameters of a search operation.

path.description:
The facade path template, e.g. `/v2/cases/{type}`. Placeholders
are single-brace `{name}` templates, Camel REST DSL / OpenAPI path
templating; `{{name}}` is the pack layer's substitution syntax and
refuses here.

pathParameters.description:
The path parameters the template names: every `{name}` in `path`
must resolve here, every entry must appear in the path, and the
list is unique (CFG-ID-6).

requestEnvelope.description:
Where a writable record sits in an incoming body. A write
operation's request envelope must name the `record` slot.

responseEnvelope.description: The response envelope; must name its result slot.

description:
The facade profile artifact (`AdapterProfile`): the operation set, the
envelope templates, the pagination parameters, and the problem codes
and problem envelope.

id.description: The profile identifier a project pins.

parameterizedParts.description: The parts of the profile a deployment declares at bind time.

problemCodes.description:
The facade problem codes, in the profile's own closed list. Route
clause bodies must carry one of these codes
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7).

problemEnvelope.description: The problem envelope template; must carry the `problemCode` slot.

version.description:
The profile's own version; a project pin names it next to the
digest (CFG-ID-4).
